text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Jingle beeel♪ Jingle beeel♪ Jingle all the way, HEY!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh what fun hahahnhaaan! Wasshoi wasshoi ×2! ...Alright, it’s done...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This is quite a grand snow sculpture. A reindeer and... hmm, what is this luxurious pedestal?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It’s “A Reindeer Riding a Festival Float.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: At least let us carry it... or is pulling it more realistic? Still, it’s huge, like 3 meters.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah! With that delicate balance... isn’t it gonna collapse any moment?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh, I’ve got Snow Sculpture Balance Certification Pre-Level 1. Despite how it looks, the stability is perfect, y’know?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Oh... then I shall take a look.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. See? This stability...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yes, “Unqualified.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah.
(BOOOOOOOM!)
Event title logo display.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Everyone, freeze!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Honestly, all of you! You must ensure maximum safety when playing in the snow! One wrong move could cause a serious accident!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My apologies... we may have taken the fun a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: But in the end, it became a good strength test. We prevented a disaster beforehand, so perhaps this is...
(Pirorirori~♪)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: From the dorm... a group message? “To the Christmas Party Operations Team”...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: “To all dorm students spending the year-end at the academy, please provide a fun Christmas party.” ...What’s this supposed to mean.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? Didn’t I tell you? The five of us are the Christmas party staff this year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......I see. If you don’t mind, could you explain how this happened?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Eeh? Should I give ya the deluxe explanation? ...It was three years ago...

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text: “Ueeeen Stegooo! I messed uuuup! I got picked for running the dorm Christmas partyyy!!”

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text: “I wrote everyone’s names on the lottery for choosing roles! It was just a silly impulse! My sis is gonna scold meee!”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: “It’s fine it’s fine! Just let ’em do it! I’ll explain it to ’em, so go and give it your all!!”

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text: “Thanks Papa! I’ll do my beeest♡♡♡♡”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...And that’s the story.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You’re totally exaggerating. At least try imitating them properly if you’re gonna tell it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: S-so that means... that’s how we ended up on the operations team!? How outrageous...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What’s wrong, Meno! Don’t tell me you’re refusing Santa’s duty!? Gonna disappoint all the good kids!? Demon! Devil!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Look who’s talking—! Writing someone else’s name without permission is unacceptable! You must reflect on your actions!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ............Still, we can’t just abandon it... In that case, the five of us must properly carry out our mission.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Complaining about backing out now would be a pain anyway. Basically we just gotta “have fun,” right? Fine, I’m in.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. You lot shall work and create a party worthy of being under my command.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It is NOT your party!! And you are also part of the operations team, so please work properly!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Everyone!! Be serious!! Do your duties responsibly!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. This is quite... a delightful situation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh right, here’s a letter for ya. Stego’s going on a little trip.
“I’m expecting the best souvenirs.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that’s how it is, sister.
